title: Weissman 2026 Fall/Winter Catalog
deck: A 136-page catalog, laid out on set.
lede: Weissman's annual Character Edition runs to 136 pages and six themed sections. Its layouts began on set, beside the shoot, over 14 days in Los Angeles.
challenge: Weissman is one of the largest dance costume companies in the United States, and its Character Edition is an annual 136-page catalog, in print and online. The 2025/2026 edition was shot in two sessions, 14 days in all, at Quixote Studios in Los Angeles. Its six themed sections each needed a character of their own, and the catalog, website and email all had to read as one system.
work: The work started on set, as production artist for both shoots, beside the camera: a multi-screen workstation in front of the cyclorama, layouts taking shape next to the live shot and the shot list taped to the wall. The catalog was then designed in InDesign for print and digital, with editorial banners for the website.

Each section has its own typographic and color identity, held together by one design system across every platform. Spreads and openers include Groovy, Far-Out Fashion, Disco Diva, On Broadway, Yasss Queen, Retro Americana, Gothic Glamour, Everyday Superhero and Happy Holidays.
The same sections became the web experience: a homepage with a cabaret silhouette hero, category tiles, and seasonal banners such as Come to the Cabaret and Sleigh the Stage.
system: Six, each with its own type and color.
Shared by print, web and email.
The catalog's sections, recut for the store.
deliverables: On-set production art, two shoots, 14 days
Editorial web banners and category tiles
credits: Dalton Corr: on-set production artist, catalog design, web and email design
